review:
Wild Cash Gold upgrades the Wild Cash series with a golden finish, fruit symbols, lucky stars and red sevens on a 5x3, 10-line layout. Its three-stage bonus is the attraction.

In the first stage, a selector moves around a track and stops on numbers, Gold or Exit; numbers add to a central multiplier over three respins. Landing Gold moves you to the second stage, where the central reel expands and values can reach 210x. The final stage can push multipliers all the way to the 25,000x maximum. Chance x2 and multiple buys are available where permitted. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 97.02% RTP.
pros: Excellent 97.02% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
